acceptPlacement.evidence: Printed "7020-A Huntley Rd. Worthington, OH 43229"; the geocoder matched "7020 HUNTLEY RD, COLUMBUS, OH, 43229". Same street number, street and ZIP code. "-A" is a unit letter, and Worthington and Columbus are both used as the post-office town for ZIP 43229.

Printed "1255 N CARPENTER RD SUITE 100 BRUNSWICK, OH 44212"; the geocoder matched "1255 CARPENTER RD N, BRUNSWICK, OH, 44212". Same number, street, town, state and ZIP code; the direction is written before the street name on the page and after it by the geocoder.
Printed "8584 Duke Boulevard in Mason, Ohio"; the geocoder matched "8584 DUKE BLVD, MASON, OH, 45040". Same number, street, town and state; the page puts the word "in" before the town.

Printed "11276 Chester Road Sharonville, OH 45246"; the geocoder matched "11276 CHESTER RD, CINCINNATI, OH, 45246". Same number, street, state and ZIP code; Sharonville and Cincinnati are both used as the post-office town for ZIP 45246.
